title: Retire qualified mailbox membership and directory rows when bound sessions leave
outcome: Deleting a bound central-native session or completing a satellite placement retires the qualified participant's membership and directory metadata without granting recreated sessions access or breaking durable receipt/idempotency retention.
acceptance: Deletion marks the qualified participant's mailbox memberships left and retires its directory discovery entry with durable fencing.
Completed placement cleanup preserves permanent identity/receipt fences while bounding obsolete directory metadata.
Focused regressions cover native deletion, completed placement and recreation; review and gate evidence cover the exact input.
